variables.name: Experience Cloud ID (ECID)
variables.description: Adobe Experience Cloud ID set automatically by AEP Web SDK. Primary cross-session visitor identity.

variables.name: Marketing Channel
variables.description: Marketing channel derived by Marketing Channel Processing Rules (rules to be defined in AA Admin).

variables.name: Tracking Code
variables.description: Campaign tracking code captured from the inbound URL query parameter. Native campaign variable.

variables.name: Campaign Source
variables.description: SAINT classification of s.campaign — traffic source (utm_source).

variables.name: Campaign Medium
variables.description: SAINT classification of s.campaign — marketing medium (utm_medium).

variables.name: Campaign Name
variables.description: SAINT classification of s.campaign — human-readable campaign name (utm_campaign).

variables.name: Campaign Content
variables.description: SAINT classification of s.campaign — creative/content variant (utm_content).

variables.name: Device Type
variables.description: Device type auto-collected by AEP Web SDK / AA device enrichment. Supports responsive mobile-first reporting (BRD 103).

variables.name: Geolocation
variables.description: Geo-location (country/region/city) derived server-side from IP by AA. No raw GPS collected (BRD 1802).

variables.name: New / Return Visitor
variables.description: New vs returning visitor status auto-derived by AA. Supports returning-visitor personalisation (BRD 704).

variables.name: Page URL
variables.description: Full page URL of the current page. Baseline global dimension on every hit.

variables.name: Business Unit
variables.description: Business unit / property identifier. Baseline global dimension for cross-property roll-up.

variables.name: Environment
variables.description: Environment flag (production / staging / dev). Backs the Production Data Only segment.

variables.name: Login / Registration Status
variables.description: Visitor registration/authentication state. Supports email-registration and optional-registration tracking.

variables.name: Hashed Visitor ID
variables.description: [Hashed — PII] SHA-256 hashed registered visitor ID for CRM/AEP profile stitching. Never store raw email.

variables.name: Student Cohort Flag
variables.description: Derived student-cohort flag from geo cluster, visit timing and referral source. Not stored as permanent PII; refreshed annually.

variables.name: Page Name
variables.description: Friendly page name for all instrumented pages across the SNF site.

variables.name: Site Section
variables.description: Top-level site section for content grouping and navigation reporting.

variables.name: Page Type
variables.description: Template/page type (home, listing, detail, policy, map, trails). Distinguishes Privacy, Terms, Cookie Policy views.

variables.name: Viewport / Delivery Mode
variables.description: Rendered viewport / responsive delivery mode (desktop / mobile) per approved wireframes.

variables.name: Brand Compliance Flag
variables.description: Flag indicating page compliance with Heritage SG brand guidelines (and presence of standard government disclaimer, BRD 106).

variables.name: SEO / Structured Data Flag
variables.description: Flag indicating presence of Schema.org JSON-LD structured data / indexability on the page (BRD 801–803).

variables.name: Programme / Installation ID
variables.description: Unique ID of the festival programme or installation in context. Also used for QR check-in installation ID.

variables.name: Programme / Installation Title
variables.description: Display title of the programme or installation being viewed/listed.

variables.name: Venue Name
variables.description: Venue associated with the programme / installation within the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct.

variables.name: Content Date / Time Slot
variables.description: Scheduled date and time slot of the programme / installation shown in listings and detail pages.

variables.name: Unlocked Content Status
variables.description: State of optional unlocked content on a programme detail page (locked / unlocked-via-QR / none). Only visible to scanned-in visitors.

variables.name: First Festival Year
variables.description: firstFestivalYear content field from AEMaaCS model — indicates debut year of the programme / installation.

variables.name: Interaction Type
variables.description: Generic interaction descriptor for key user interactions (CTA click, expand, filter, share, etc.).

variables.name: Klook Ticketing CTA
variables.description: Context of the Klook ticketing call-to-action click directing visitors off-site (programme/installation referenced).

variables.name: Map Interaction Context
variables.description: Context of interactive precinct map interactions (pin click, zoom, listing open) on the MapBox map.

variables.name: Location Permission State
variables.description: Visitor's location-permission state (granted / denied) governing proximity sorting and default listing behaviour.

variables.name: Derived Zone Label
variables.description: Client-side derived zone label passed to Adobe Target. Raw GPS never stored server-side (PDPA).

variables.name: Venue Crowd Density Level
variables.description: Live per-venue crowd density indicator level derived from real-time AA session data (low / medium / high).

variables.name: Trail Name
variables.description: Name of the curated self-guided trail being presented, selected or followed.

variables.name: Trail / Itinerary ID
variables.description: Unique ID of the trail or custom itinerary (used for save/follow, sharing, adoption and Community Picks).

variables.name: Itinerary Source
variables.description: Origin of the itinerary in context (self-created / shared-view / one-tap-adopted / community-pick).

variables.name: Itinerary Optimisation Suggestion
variables.description: Type of inline optimisation suggestion surfaced for itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies (dismissible, non-blocking).

variables.name: Registration Trigger Moment
variables.description: The moment/context that triggered registration (QR first scan, itinerary adoption, save trail, manual). Drives funnel-by-trigger reporting.

variables.name: Consent Tier Selection
variables.description: Three-tier consent model selection captured at registration (Tier 0 Functional / Tier 1 Festival Marketing / Tier 2 Year-Round NHB).

variables.name: Consent Action
variables.description: Consent action captured for the consent log (grant / withdraw) by tier, effective immediately via self-service settings.

variables.name: Cookie Consent Category
variables.description: Cookie consent categories accepted (Strictly Necessary / Analytics & Performance / Personalisation & Targeting).

variables.name: Personalisation Use Case
variables.description: Active Adobe Target personalisation use case in context (your-picks / trending-circle / returning-banner / last-chance).

variables.name: Recommendation Context
variables.description: Context of an affinity-matched recommendation shown or clicked (feed position, programme recommended).

variables.name: Share Method
variables.description: Method used for itinerary sharing via native device share (no social OAuth). Captures channel chosen by OS share sheet.

variables.name: Brand Concierge Intent
variables.description: Visitor intent classified in a Brand Concierge interaction (programme discovery / trail recommendation / venue info / general info).

variables.name: Brand Concierge Outcome
variables.description: Outcome of a Brand Concierge interaction (answered / escalated / failed) for engagement and escalation-rate reporting.

variables.name: AI / Agentic Discovery Source
variables.description: Referral source indicating discovery via AI-powered/agentic search or LLM crawler (GEO/LLMO). Captured from referrer/UA heuristics.

variables.name: Marketing Channel
variables.description: OOTB marketing channel reporting — mirror of the OOTB dimension; no custom prop allocated.

variables.name: Page URL
variables.description: Mirror of the Page URL eVar for PathFinder / pathing analysis. Baseline variable.

variables.name: Business Unit
variables.description: Mirror of the Business Unit eVar for pathing / ClickMap segmentation. Baseline variable.

variables.name: Page Name
variables.description: Mirror of the Page Name eVar for PathFinder pathing across the SNF site. Supports page-tagging requirement.

variables.name: Site Section
variables.description: Mirror of the Site Section eVar for next-page-flow pathing through the SNF site hierarchy.

variables.name: Page Type
variables.description: Mirror of the Page Type eVar for pathing between listing, detail and policy page templates.

variables.name: Programme / Installation Name
variables.description: Mirror of the Programme / Installation Name eVar for pathing across festival content items.

variables.name: Venue Name
variables.description: Mirror of the Venue Name eVar for pathing / ClickMap of precinct venue interactions.

variables.name: Trail Name
variables.description: Mirror of the Trail Name eVar for pathing through curated and custom trail flows.

variables.name: Registration Trigger Moment
variables.description: Mirror of the Registration Trigger Moment eVar for pathing analysis of which moment drove registration (QR scan, trail save, share adoption).

variables.name: Brand Concierge Query Intent
variables.description: Mirror of the Brand Concierge Query Intent eVar for pathing of intent sequences within concierge sessions.

variables.name: Custom Page View
variables.description: Counts a custom page view on every page load. Baseline instance metric for all pages.

variables.name: Page Load Time (ms)
variables.description: Numeric page load time in milliseconds. Paired with Page Load Time Instances to build the Avg Page Load Time calculated metric.

variables.name: Page Load Time Instances
variables.description: Counter firing each time a page load time value is recorded. Denominator for the Avg Page Load Time calculated metric.

variables.name: Programme/Installation Listing View
variables.description: Fires on display of a festival programme or installation listing (title, description, venue, dates/times). BRD 104.

variables.name: Privacy Policy Page View
variables.description: Counts Privacy Policy page views documenting PDPA data collection, purpose, retention and visitor rights. BRD 107.

variables.name: Terms of Use Page View
variables.description: Counts Terms of Use page views. BRD 108.

variables.name: Cookie Policy Page View
variables.description: Counts Cookie Policy page views documenting all cookies, purpose, category and retention. BRD 1812.

variables.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Click (Exit)
variables.description: Fires when a visitor clicks the Klook ticketing call-to-action directing off-site. Exit link; no ticketing built on SNF site. BRD 105.

variables.name: Unlocked Content View (QR-gated)
variables.description: Fires when QR-gated unlocked content is rendered to a physically scanned-in visitor on the programme detail page. BRD 602/605.

variables.name: Registration Start
variables.description: Fires when a visitor begins the mobile-optimised email registration flow. Funnel start event. BRD 202/1205.

variables.name: Email Verification Complete
variables.description: Fires on successful email registration verified via one-time code or link. Registration complete event. BRD 201.

variables.name: Registration Fail
variables.description: Fires when the email registration/verification attempt fails. Funnel fail event. BRD 201/202.

variables.name: Consent Granted
variables.description: Fires when a visitor positively grants a consent tier (Tier 0/1/2) at registration. BRD 301/302.

variables.name: Consent Withdrawn
variables.description: Fires when a visitor withdraws consent via self-service profile settings, effective immediately. BRD 303/304.

variables.name: Cookie Consent Selection
variables.description: Fires when a visitor records a cookie consent choice via the banner or settings control. BRD 1809/1810/1811.

variables.name: Data Subject Request
variables.description: Fires on a self-service view, correction or erasure request of personal data. BRD 1805.

variables.name: Map Interaction
variables.description: Fires on interaction with the interactive Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map (pin tap, pan, zoom). BRD 401/402.

variables.name: Location Permission Response
variables.description: Fires when the visitor grants or denies location permission, driving proximity sorting vs default listing. BRD 403/404.

variables.name: Trail Saved
variables.description: Fires when a registered visitor saves a curated self-guided trail to follow. BRD 502.

variables.name: Itinerary Item Added
variables.description: Fires when a visitor adds a chosen programme or installation to a custom itinerary. BRD 503.

variables.name: Itinerary Optimisation Suggestion Shown
variables.description: Fires when a dismissible, non-blocking inline optimisation suggestion is surfaced for itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies. BRD 504.

variables.name: Itinerary Shared
variables.description: Fires when a visitor shares an itinerary via native device share. BRD 505/705.

variables.name: Shared Itinerary View (Unauthenticated)
variables.description: Fires when a shared itinerary is viewed without authentication. BRD 506.

variables.name: Itinerary One-Tap Adoption
variables.description: Fires on one-tap adoption of a shared itinerary, triggering a light registration prompt. BRD 506/705.

variables.name: Community Picks Surfaced
variables.description: Fires when an itinerary reaches ≥10 unique festival-window adoptions and is surfaced as a Community Pick on the Trails page. BRD 507/705.

variables.name: QR Scan Check-in
variables.description: Fires on a QR scan recorded against the visitor profile as a confirmed check-in, capturing installation ID and timestamp. BRD 601/604/1803.

variables.name: First-Scan Registration Prompt Shown
variables.description: Fires when a dismissible email registration prompt is shown on the first QR scan by an unauthenticated visitor. BRD 603.

variables.name: Bookmark Added
variables.description: Fires when a visitor bookmarks a programme, feeding the 'Your picks tonight' bookmark-based feed. BRD 702/704.

variables.name: Personalised Recommendation Impression
variables.description: Fires when an Adobe Target personalised recommendation, trending chip or contextual banner is rendered. BRD 701/702/703/704/706.

variables.name: Brand Concierge Interaction
variables.description: Fires on a Brand Concierge interaction, instrumented for engagement, query intent and escalation/failure tracking. BRD 1405/1406.

segments.name: Bounce Rate
segments.description: Percentage of single-hit visits with no further interaction. Baseline calculated metric for engagement quality monitoring.

segments.name: Conversion Rate
segments.description: Ratio of a target success event to visits. Baseline calculated metric; instance used for registration funnel and QR check-in conversion reporting.

segments.name: Pages per Visit
segments.description: Average page views per visit. Baseline engagement calculated metric.

segments.name: All Visits
segments.description: Baseline visit-scope segment including all qualifying visits. Used as the default denominator for reporting.

segments.name: New Visitors
segments.description: Baseline visitor-scope segment isolating first-time visitors (OOTB New/Return visitor dimension).

segments.name: Returning Visitors
segments.description: Baseline visitor-scope segment isolating returning visitors (OOTB New/Return visitor dimension). Supports returning-visitor contextual banner reporting.

segments.name: Authenticated Users
segments.description: Baseline visitor-scope segment isolating registered/email-verified visitors based on the Login Status eVar.

segments.name: Production Data Only
segments.description: Mandatory baseline segment restricting reporting to production hits (Environment eVar = "production"), excluding dev/stage traffic.

segments.name: Tier 1 Festival Marketing Consent
segments.description: Visitors who positively granted Tier 1 (Festival Marketing) consent at registration. Supports consent tier distribution reporting (BRD 301, 1204).

segments.name: Tier 2 Year-Round NHB Consent
segments.description: Visitors who positively granted Tier 2 (Year-Round NHB) consent at registration (BRD 301, 1204).

segments.name: Consent Withdrawn
segments.description: Visitors who withdrew consent via self-service profile settings. Supports consent log and withdrawal reporting (BRD 303, 304).

segments.name: Analytics Cookie Consent Granted
segments.description: Visitors who granted Analytics & Performance cookie consent category. Supports PDPA cookie consent reporting (BRD 1808, 1809).

segments.name: Registration Started
segments.description: Visits where the email registration flow was initiated. Supports registration funnel entry reporting (BRD 201, 202, 1205).

segments.name: Registration Completed
segments.description: Visits where email registration was verified and completed. Supports registration funnel completion reporting (BRD 201, 202, 1205).

segments.name: Registration by Trigger Moment
segments.description: Registration completions segmented by the trigger moment eVar (e.g. QR prompt, itinerary adoption). Supports funnel-by-trigger reporting (BRD 1205).

segments.name: QR Check-in Visitors
segments.description: Visitors with one or more confirmed QR check-in events against their profile. Supports QR rate reporting (BRD 601, 604, 1201).

segments.name: Unlocked Content Viewers
segments.description: Visits that viewed QR-unlocked content available only to physically scanned-in visitors (BRD 602, 605).

segments.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Clickers
segments.description: Visits that clicked the off-site Klook ticketing call-to-action (BRD 105).

segments.name: Brand Concierge Users
segments.description: Visits that engaged with Adobe Brand Concierge. Supports engagement/intent/escalation reporting (BRD 1404, 1405, 1406).

segments.name: Trail Followers
segments.description: Registered visitors who saved and followed a self-guided trail with QR check-in progress (BRD 501, 502).

segments.name: Itinerary Creators
segments.description: Visits that created a custom itinerary by adding programmes/installations (BRD 503).

segments.name: Itinerary Sharers
segments.description: Visits that shared an itinerary via native device share (BRD 505, 705).

segments.name: Shared Itinerary Adopters
segments.description: Visits that performed one-tap adoption of a shared itinerary. Supports Community Picks ≥10 adoptions reporting (BRD 506, 507, 705).

segments.name: Location Permission Granted
segments.description: Visits where the visitor granted location permission, enabling proximity-based sorting (BRD 403, 404).

segments.name: Map Interaction Sessions
